title: SDXL + Krea 2 gain the Inpaint op (wf_type 5), and the re-exported LTX graph lands
description: Fabio re-exported three raw graphs: sdxl_t2i_template and krea2_t2i_template grew a LanPaint inpaint branch on Input_wf_type 5, and ltx_i2v_t2v_template was rebuilt for quality. Sync raw->API->runtime, then wire the shared `inpaint` op into all five SDXL cards and both Krea 2 cards.
